name: RS3
description: RS3 is a behavioral stress-test suite consisting of 20 hand-crafted archetypes spanning five categories designed to evaluate structural failure modes in LLM agent trajectories. It supports the detection of competence illusions such as sycophancy, specification gaming, temporal degradation, and false confidence projection by analyzing agent behavior beyond output correctness.
reputation: A small, specialized behavioral stress-test suite from recent research; not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Focuses on structural trajectory analysis of LLM agents to detect failure modes invisible to output-only evaluation.
